headlines.title: China’s R&D spending hits record 2.8% of GDP, beating OECD average for the first time
headlines.summary:
For the first time, China’s spending on research and development as a share of gross domestic product has surpassed the average for Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) members – a trend one analyst expects to continue as Beijing seeks to strengthen technological self-reliance amid intensifying global competition.
R&D expenditure exceeded 3.92 trillion yuan (US$584.8 billion) in 2025, accounting for 2.8 per cent of GDP, Science and Technology Minister Yin Hejun said at a...

headlines.title: 事关商品住房预售、现房销售 多地新规出台

headlines.title_en: New regulations on commercial housing pre-sales and completed-home sales introduced in multiple regions
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou in Guangdong Province, and Wuhan in Hubei Province have successively issued implementation opinions to carry out the Notice on Improving the Commodity Housing Sales System. What changes do the new rules bring, and how do they enhance homebuyers' sense of security? Which new homes can be sold as completed housing? Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Wuhan have all made clear that August 28, 2026 will serve as the cutoff date (the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources, and the National Financial Regulatory Administration jointly issued the Notice on Improving the Commodity Housing Sales System on August 28), and after that, commodity housing projects with newly announced land transfer notices will give priority to sales of completed housing. Beijing and Shanghai have explicitly required that only after a project completes the first registration of the property—that is, after the project is completed and obtains the "major property rights certificate"—can it apply for completed housing sales filing. Wuhan requires that after real estate development enterprises complete the first registration of real estate, they should also formulate a completed housing sales plan,

headlines.title: Shanghai Gold Exchange pushes more Chinese banks to end retail leverage trading
headlines.summary:
At least a dozen Chinese banks intend to wind down retail leveraged precious-metals trading – a practice in which everyday investors post margin deposits to speculate on gold and silver contracts without owning the physical metal.
The retreat comes amid sharp swings in international gold prices. Sources at two banks, including the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China – the world’s largest lender by assets – said that this round of withdrawals was mandated by the Shanghai Gold Exchange,...

headlines.title_en: UK two-year gilt yields fall more than 8 basis points; 10-year gilt yields retreat after hitting highest since 2007
headlines.summary_en: Thursday (October 1) late in the European session, the UK 10-year government bond yield fell 2.7 basis points to 5.398%, showing an overall M-shaped trend, having reached 5.504% early in the European stock session, approaching the third-quarter 2007 peak of 5.564%, the first-quarter 2000 high of 5.899%, and the first-quarter 1998 high of 6.307%. The two-year UK gilt yield fell 8.6 basis points to 4.801%, having also risen to 4.970% at 15:30 Beijing time (approaching the September 14 peak of 4.971%), then continued to fall. The 30-year UK gilt yield fell 0.4 basis points to 5.945%, having reached 6.021% at 15:37, breaking above the 6% psychological threshold for the first time since the first quarter of 1998; the 50-year UK gilt yield fell 1.5 basis points. 2/10-year UK gilts

headlines.title: 法国监督机构称预算草案的经济假设“乐观”，政府降赤字计划面临风险
headlines.summary: 法国财政监督机构警告称，政府2027年预算草案所依据的经济假设“乐观”，这给削减高企财政赤字的计划带来风险。法国政府周四早些时候向内阁提交了一项财政法案，预计经济增速将从2026年的0.5%加快至1%，并计划将财政赤字占国内生产总值(GDP)的比例从5.4%降至5%。负责监督公共财政的独立机构法国公共财政高级委员会(HCFP)表示，这些预测假设私人投资将显著回升，但法国主权借贷成本飙升可能会传导至企业和家庭的融资环境。

headlines.title_en: French watchdog says budget draft's economic assumptions are 'optimistic,' government deficit reduction plan at risk
headlines.summary_en: France's fiscal watchdog warned that the economic assumptions underlying the government's 2027 budget draft are "optimistic," posing risks to the plan to reduce the high fiscal deficit. The French government earlier on Thursday submitted a finance bill to the cabinet, forecasting economic growth to accelerate from 0.5% in 2026 to 1%, and planning to reduce the fiscal deficit as a share of gross domestic product (GDP) from 5.4% to 5%. The High Council of Public Finance (HCFP), an independent body responsible for monitoring public finances, said these forecasts assume a significant rebound in private investment, but the surge in France's sovereign borrowing costs may feed through to the financing environment for businesses and households.

headlines.title: 问界汽车：华为与赛力斯达成新五年合作
headlines.summary: 问界汽车宣布，9月30日，鸿蒙智行问界业务升级战略合作签约仪式在深圳举行。华为常务董事、产品投资评审委员会主任、终端BG董事长余承东，赛力斯集团董事长（创始人）张兴海等出席签约仪式。华为与赛力斯表示，面向新五年，双方将持续锚定问界高端智能汽车品牌核心定位，联合组建问界业务专属团队，进一步升级问界业务。

headlines.title_en: AITO: Huawei and Seres reach new five-year cooperation
headlines.summary_en: AITO announced that on September 30, the HarmonyOS Smart Mobility AITO business upgrade strategic cooperation signing ceremony was held in Shenzhen. Huawei Executive Director, Product Investment Review Committee Director, and Terminal BG Chairman Yu Chengdong, Seres Group Chairman (Founder) Zhang Xinghai, and others attended the signing ceremony. Huawei and Seres said that for the new five years, the two sides will continue to firmly anchor the core positioning of the AITO high-end smart car brand, jointly form a dedicated team for the AITO business, and further upgrade the AITO business.
